headline: 9 Solana addresses catalogued (2 V1 programs, 5 protocol token mints, 1 collateral asset, 1 pair account). No admin, upgrade-authority or V2 program addresses found.
short_headline: 9 addresses on Solana; no admin found

findings.text: Solscan fetch for the Exchange program failed, and no explorer name-tag search was possible. Addresses come from the official docs page and from search-result bodies (Eco docs).

The docs 'Onchain Addresses' page lists 2 V1 programs (Exchange v0.1, Stability Pool v0.1), 5 token mints (hyUSD, eHYUSD, xSOL, hyloSOL, hyloSOL+) and cbBTC as an exogenous collateral asset. The V2 xBTC mint is listed as TBD, and no V2 program addresses are listed.
docs.hylo.so/security/audits lists 3 audits: OtterSec (Feb 2025), Accretion (Dec 2025) and Accretion V2 (Jul 2026). The PDFs were not opened this run, so no audit-scope addresses were extracted.

The hylo-so/sdk repo (Rust crates, including hylo-idl) was fetched at the repo root with no commit SHA pinned. The hylo-idl subtree could not be fetched, so no deployment artifacts or V2 program IDs were extracted.
Solana is the only chain. Addresses came from the docs page; the explorer was unreachable.
No factory contracts were identified. Hylo uses per-asset pools and PDAs, and no enumeration view was readable. The defipunkd read API does not cover Solana.
Programs are tagged role 'other (program)'. Mints are tagged 'token'. Actor class is 'unknown' throughout because no bytecode or authority was read.
All admin_addresses entries trace to a fetched docs page or a search-result body in evidence[]. No upgrade authority, multisig or timelock address was surfaced.

rationale.verdict: Walked the Hylo docs (addresses, audits, resources), the GitHub SDK root and two searches. 9 Solana addresses were catalogued; no control-surface addresses (upgrade authority or multisig) were found.

evidence.shows: Official Hylo docs page listing Solana mainnet addresses. Programs: Exchange v0.1 HYEXCHtHkBagdStcJCp3xbbb9B7sdMdWXFNj6mdsG4hn and Stability Pool v0.1 HysTabVUfmQBFcmzu1ctRd1Y1fxd66RBpboy1bmtDSQQ. Mints: hyUSD, eHYUSD, xSOL, hyloSOL, hyloSOL+. Collateral: cbBTC. The xBTC mint is TBD.
Audit index: OtterSec Feb 2025 (V1 Exchange & Stability Pool), Accretion Dec 2025 (v1.2), Accretion Jul 2026 (V2 Exchange, Earn Pool & Router).

Docs index. It names the Onchain Addresses and Audits pages, and describes hyUSD/eHYUSD, xAssets and the LSTs hyloSOL/hyloSOL+. It also shows that V2 adds a multi-asset architecture, an Earn Pool and Router, and has no governance-forum or bug-bounty page.
Points to the open-source Rust SDK at github.com/hylo-so/sdk (crates hylo-core, hylo-idl, hylo-clients, hylo-quotes, hylo-jupiter, hylo-stats). Says public APIs are coming soon.
Public repo hylo-so/sdk (MPL-2.0). Contains the Rust crates and 121 commits on main. No deployments file was visible at the root. No commit SHA was captured.
Website loads (the leverage page). Navigation: Leverage, Earn, Stake, Portfolio. No addresses shown.

Third-party SDK docs (search-result body). They list HYLO_PROGRAM_ID as the Exchange program (same as the official docs), HYUSD_MINT as 5YMkXAYccHSGnHn9nob9xEvv6Pvka9DZWH7nTbotTu9E, and the USDC<->hyUSD pair account PDA CMNPACEDebyvNJDgBxRc5fbScF8kmx52ZPBY4Cu4wuwS. The pair account is a derived value from a non-official source.

Third-party SDK docs (search-result body). They list the Stability/Earn Pool program ID as HysTabVUfmQBFcmzu1ctRd1Y1fxd66RBpboy1bmtDSQQ, which matches the official docs. They also say the pool's mints are PDAs.
Search-result body only. The OtterSec assessment covers the stability-pool and exchange programs, conducted Feb 10-27, 2025 with a follow-up. No address table was seen in the snippet.

unknowns: D1-offchain: fetch of https://solscan.io/account/HYEXCHtHkBagdStcJCp3xbbb9B7sdMdWXFNj6mdsG4hn failed (URL could not be accessed). No on-chain data was read this run, so program upgrade authority and program data are unknown.
D1: No explorer name-tag search was possible for Solana (Solscan unreachable). Only docs and search-result sightings were used.

D2: Docs list only V1 program addresses. The V2 programs (Exchange, Earn Pool, Router) audited by Accretion in Jul 2026 have no address on the docs page. The xBTC mint is TBD. The V2 multi-asset collateral pools, per-asset vaults, and the V2 mint PDAs (xBTC etc.) were not found.

D3: Audit PDFs (OtterSec Feb 2025, Accretion Dec 2025, Accretion Jul 2026) were not opened. Only the OtterSec PDF appeared, as a search snippet, with no scope address table. Scope addresses, including audit-era addresses, were not extracted.

D4: hylo-idl and other SDK subdirectories could not be fetched (github.com tree URL permission denied; tool call budget exhausted). Program IDs, PDAs and any deployments file in the repo were not extracted. No commit SHA was pinned. The Hylo on-chain program source repo was not identified; protocol.github was empty.
D5: chain Solana: addresses surfaced only from docs.hylo.so and third-party SDK docs. Explorer and repo artifacts were unavailable.
D6: No factory-style enumeration was possible. The defipunkd read API does not support Solana, and per-asset pool/vault accounts for V2 were not discovered.

D7: No admin, upgrade authority, multisig, timelock or guardian address was discovered. This includes the program upgrade authority for the Exchange and Stability/Earn programs, and the Pyth oracle feed accounts. Downstream control slices must find them.

D8: The USDC<->hyUSD pair account CMNPACEDebyvNJDgBxRc5fbScF8kmx52ZPBY4Cu4wuwS came from a third-party SDK doc and is unverified on an explorer. It is included in admin_addresses with an unknown actor class.
D2: Governance forum, bug bounty URL and security contact were not found in the fetched pages. docs_url is set from the fetched docs pages.
D2: Upgradeability of the Solana programs is not determined, so protocol_metadata.upgradeability is 'unknown'.

protocol_metadata.about: Hylo is a Solana protocol where users mint hyUSD, a decentralized stablecoin, and xAssets such as xSOL, which give liquidation-resistant leveraged long exposure. hyUSD can be deposited into an Earn Pool to receive the yield-bearing eHYUSD. Per its docs, V2 adds a multi-asset collateral architecture with dynamic routing across pools and autonomous collateral rebalancing. Hylo also issues liquid staking tokens (hyloSOL and hyloSOL+).
